result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Customer may terminate on 30 days' written notice, owes no early-termination fee, and receives a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees for the post-termination period; Vendor has no convenience-termination right during a term. The existing cause-based termination rights and term structure are preserved. The amendment is focused and professionally drafted, although the new provision should be numbered (presumably Section 9.4), and “in part” could be clarified if partial termination of an Agreement or Order Form is intended.
